paragraphs: The M850i xDrive is the V8 flagship of the current 8 Series range, launched in 2018 with the G14/G15/G16 generation and continuing through to the present day. It uses the N63 — BMW's 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, the same engine family that appears in a number of high-performance BMW models. The hot-vee turbo layout means the turbos sit within the V of the engine, which is a packaging choice that brings known considerations around heat soak, valve seals and coolant components over time — exactly the areas we address as standard on every N63 rebuild.
about.boldParagraph: The M850i xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
